name: Aisa
source:
Pronouns: He/She/They
[spoiler]Occupation: Lumine[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Affiliation: Dawn Court[/spoiler]
Age: Unknown

Likes: Forests, rivers, sunny days
Dislikes: People who take things for granted
Hobbies: Hunting, weapon care, meditation

[spoiler]Specialty: Plant Manipulation[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Signature Technique: Step into Nature. Aisa has a special connection with nature that allows him to connect with the natural elements around him, granting them slight, temporary omnipotence.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]A Fae, a being shrouded in mystery, Aisa appears averse to you, eluding you every time you try to get close. They're quick to disappear. A strong contrast to Kuna'a. And they appear to be wary of your presence.

On your first encounter, Aisa had an expression that can only be described as surprise when you approached them. Since then, their surprise seems to have only increased with each interaction. Where Kuna'a appears eager to talk, Aisa couldn't reject your presence more.

And yet, you keep crossing paths. They seem knowledgeable of Kuna'a, and even of you, to an extent. Where do they fall in all of this?[/spoiler]

[From in-game profile]
